Chief Electrician’s Mate John Gerard, who has served in the state’s naval force since 2018, has been awarded the Josephthal Award.



Established in 1929 by Naval Militia Rear Admiral Louis Josephthal, who was then the commander, the annual award recognizes an outstanding individual Naval Militia member and an outstanding unit.
